failure_patterns.pattern: duplicate_optional_key: A filled `optional parameters` list was followed by a second empty `"optional parameters": []` key. This erased enable (education:23), page (education:72) and get_test (education:28). The skill already shows this exact bad string four times.

rejected_edits.content: Type the name character for character from the `### ` line, so a colon always sits between provider and endpoint (a heading shown as `Provider — endpoint` is written `Provider: endpoint`). BAD (missing endpoint) `BestBuy Product Data`. GOOD
rejected_edits.target: BAD `Lost Ark — get engravings`, `Wayfair — This API helps to query...`, `BestBuy Product Data`. GOOD

rejected_edits.content: - VALUE FORMAT FOLLOWS THE PARAM DESCRIPTION. When the schema text shows a format, convert the query's wording to it: 'Germany' with `country` described as 'E.g, ES, DE, US' -> `DE`; 'June 21st' -> `month`=`6`, `day`=`21`; 'American Airlines (AA)' -> `ident`=`AA`; an enum word in the clause fills a required enum ('seasonal challenges' -> `type`=`seasonal`).
rejected_edits.target: Never emit a parameter with an empty value.
